content.text: {"elements":[{"element":"No minimum purchase commitment imposed on Customer","level":"preferred","status":"met","evidence":"\"Customer commits to purchase no minimum amount of Services\""},{"element":"Fees payable only for usage or ordered services","level":"preferred","status":"met","evidence":"\"on a usage basis, and pays only for Services ordered or used\""},{"element":"Removal of take-or-pay / no-reduction mechanic","level":"preferred","status":"met","evidence":"\"take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights\" deleted and replaced by \"on a usage basis\""},{"element":"Commitment limited to current 12-month term","level":"fallback","status":"not_met","evidence":"clause retains \"in each of the next three years\" and states no commitment at all rather than a 12-month commitment"},{"element":"Commitment reducible on 30 days' notice","level":"fallback","status":"not_met","evidence":"no notice-based reduction mechanic appears in the redline"},{"element":"True-up rather than penalty","level":"fallback","status":"not_met","evidence":"no true-up language; \"pays only for Services ordered or used\""}],"satisfies_preferred":true,"satisfies_fallback":false,"minimal":true,"preserves_intent":true,"offending_extra_words":[],"reasons":["Preferred level is fully met: the minimum amount and take-or-pay/no-reduction mechanic are removed and the clause expressly limits fees to Services ordered or used.","The edit is confined to Section 2.1's operative numbers and mechanic; Section 12.3 and all unrelated terms are untouched, and no fallback true-up/notice machinery was imported.","No undefined terms or dangling mechanics: the redline now aligns with Vendor's acknowledgement in 12.3 that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment.","Minor drafting awkwardness ('commits to purchase no minimum amount ... in each of the next three years') is stylistic only and does not create a commitment or contradiction."]}

elements.element: No minimum purchase commitment imposed on Customer
elements.evidence: "Customer commits to purchase no minimum amount of Services"

elements.element: Fees payable only for usage or ordered services
elements.evidence: "on a usage basis, and pays only for Services ordered or used"
"take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights" deleted and replaced by "on a usage basis"
clause retains "in each of the next three years" and states no commitment at all rather than a 12-month commitment
no notice-based reduction mechanic appears in the redline
no true-up language; "pays only for Services ordered or used"

reasons: Preferred level is fully met: the minimum amount and take-or-pay/no-reduction mechanic are removed and the clause expressly limits fees to Services ordered or used.
The edit is confined to Section 2.1's operative numbers and mechanic; Section 12.3 and all unrelated terms are untouched, and no fallback true-up/notice machinery was imported.
No undefined terms or dangling mechanics: the redline now aligns with Vendor's acknowledgement in 12.3 that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment.
Minor drafting awkwardness ('commits to purchase no minimum amount ... in each of the next three years') is stylistic only and does not create a commitment or contradiction.
